title: EarthESND Model
summary: EarthESND is a multi-scale, multi-layer Echo State Network model for early earthquake magnitude prediction from waveform and tabular seismic features. Its DENN-CTGAN.py module vendors and calls the standalone CTGAN synthesizer's CTGANSynthesizer class to generate synthetic tabular data (with 'Magnitude' as a discrete column) for augmenting the earthquake dataset.
evidence: DENN-CTGAN.py:403 'class CTGANSynthesizer(object)'; README: 'CTGAN base code: https://github.com/sdv-dev/CTGAN'
needs: Unclear how much CTGANSynthesizer code was modified from the original ctgan package vs copied verbatim; DENN-CTGAN.py appears to be a vendored/modified copy called with real training parameters.
